units.source_text: 可左思右想，反倒愈來愈依賴靜子，

en.t: But the more I thought it over, the more I ended up depending on Shizuko,

units.source_text: 包括我離家出走後的各種善後工作，幾乎全部都由這位不讓鬚眉的甲州女強人來一手操持，

en.t: including all the arrangements after I ran away from home, almost everything was handled single-handedly by this formidable woman from Koshu,

units.source_text: 結果在靜子面前，我不得不變得越來越「戰戰兢兢」。

en.t: and as a result, in front of Shizuko, I had no choice but to become more and more timid and anxious.

units.source_text: 在靜子的安排下，比目魚、堀木、靜子三人協商後達成協議，

en.t: Through Shizuko's arrangements, Flounder, Horiki, and Shizuko discussed matters and reached an agreement,

units.source_text: 我就此與老家徹底斷絕關係，與靜子開始過著「光明正大」的同居生活。

en.t: and so I completely severed ties with my family home and began living openly with Shizuko.

units.source_text: 在靜子的多方奔走下，我的漫畫也意外地賣了一些錢，

en.t: Thanks to Shizuko running around on my behalf, my cartoons unexpectedly brought in some money,

units.source_text: 我用這些錢買菸買酒，但我的不安和鬱悶卻有增無減。

en.t: I used that money to buy cigarettes and alcohol, but my unease and gloom only kept growing.
